charges_per_fill_inr._formula: value = price * qty; buy = value if BUY else 0; sell = value if SELL else 0

rules: SL and SL-M fills: trigger moved 10 bps against the order (BUY up, SELL down); SL is then clamped to its limit
MARKET fill with no quote book: last price moved 5 bps against the order
MARKET fill with a quote book: fill at the book (ask for BUY, bid for SELL)
a slipped price never goes below 0.01

fills.live_arm: entry and exits booked at the actual sandbox fill
fills.replay: decide on a completed bar, fill on the NEXT bar's open; stop fills at fill - 40 or the gap if the bar opens through it

data.index_bars: BANKNIFTY 5m history for today, from the broker (Zerodha)
data.option_quotes: NFO LTP / depth for the day's CE and PE
data.instrument_master: NFO list for lot size and expiries
data.minute_snapshots: desktop only: MARKET_DATA_COLLECTOR_ENABLED=TRUE writes one multi-quote call per minute 09:15-15:30 (BANKNIFTY, NIFTY, SENSEX, INDIA VIX, near-ATM options) to db/market_snapshots.duckdb; nothing in it feeds the arms
